lines.text: Hezekiah tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, entered the LORD's house, and sent Eliakim, Shebna, and priests to Isaiah.
Hezekiah's message said children had reached the point of birth, and asked Isaiah to pray for the remnant.
Isaiah said the LORD would send a spirit on Assyria's king, and the Rabshakeh found him fighting Gath.
Sennacherib, warned about Tirhakah of Egypt, sent a letter, and Hezekiah read it and spread it before the LORD.
Hezekiah prayed that the LORD would save them from Sennacherib so all kingdoms would know He alone is God.
